items.summary: Ownership behind Danish dermatology drugmaker Leo Pharma has opted to delay the company's plans for a 2026 IPO in the wake of ongoing market volatility.

items.title: Eisai, Linus Health launch ‘brain health’ digital resource
items.summary: Japanese Big Pharma Eisai is teaming up with Boston-based digital health company Linus Health to create new “Brain Health Reports.”

items.title: With Klygefa approvals, AZ expands myasthenia gravis domain beyond Soliris, Ultomiris
items.summary: Continuing to harvest a bounty of autumn approvals, AstraZeneca has picked up nods for its C5 inhibitor gefurulimab to treat generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) on both sides of the Atlantic.

items.title: Quality over quantity: Healthcare messages not tuned into patient needs, survey finds
items.summary: 58% of patients out of a 1,500 patient survey reported that healthcare communications don't consistently feel relevant to their needs, behavioral science-focused Lirio found.

items.title: Measurement Everywhere: Why the Future Can’t Be Measured in the Rearview Mirror
items.summary: Stop measuring marketing in the rearview mirror. See how continuous measurement turns trusted signals into smarter decisions and action.

items.title: Digital Twins: Advancing Clinical Evidence Strategy
items.summary: Learn how patient digital twins can model treatment scenarios, strengthen comparator strategies and support evidence generation.

items.title: Genentech brings every day wins to life in patient-focused Hemlibra push
items.summary: New videos for Genentech’s “Life Doesn’t Wait” campaign showcase real patients and their families as they prove that their rare disease doesn't stop them from everyday life.

items.title: AstraZeneca cuts 600 US sales jobs amid $1.5B savings plan: Bloomberg
items.summary: AstraZeneca’s $1.5 billion cost-savings drive has started to take a toll on its U.S. workforce. The British pharma has cut about 600 jobs from its respiratory and immunology commercial teams in the U.S., Bloomberg reports.

items.title: AZ keeps pressure on Keytruda with Imfinzi expansion in chemo-ineligible bladder cancer
items.summary: Looking to challenge a preeminent Keytruda cocktail in cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC), AstraZeneca has crossed the finish line with its own doublet wedding Pfizer and Astellas’ Padcev with its PD-L1 inhibitor Imfinzi.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill keep scripts on the ascent
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: Europe's CHMP backs Baxfendy, gives Hansoh's Aumseqa another chance
items.summary: Amid a slate of regulatory decisions this week, the CHMP backed AstraZeneca's Baxfendy and endorsed Hansoh's application for Aumseqa after revoking its original marketing authorization earlier this summer.

items.title: Teva CEO 'proud' of pipeline buzz as innovative-generics hybrid rolls out 1st R&D day
items.summary: While acknowledging that Teva’s peak sales estimate for its tranche of late-stage pipeline darlings may be verging on “aspirational,” at least one analyst team walked away from the company’s first R&D investor confab this week feeling “increasingly confident” in the firm’s direction.

items.title: Bavarian Nordic C-suite stability in question as CFO steps down amid Q3 beat
items.summary: As Bavarian Nordic’s new CEO Tarja Stenvall makes her debut, CFO Henrik Juuel is stepping down.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China’s Big Pharma ambition; Treasury’s China crackdown; Takeda’s narcolepsy launch
items.summary: Chinese companies have a Big Pharma dream. Experts told Fierce that the U.S. Treasury's draft policy on banning certain U.S. investments in China is too ambiguous and could backfire. Takeda's novel orexin drug has won a favorable DEA designation. And more.

items.title: Sanofi teams with British comic Beano for Type 1 diabetes education push
items.summary: Sanofi’s U.K. business is partnering up with British comic stalwart the Beano once again to help British schools boost awareness of Type 1 diabetes.

items.title: Novo amps up Wegovy marketing with DJ Khaled spinning his weight-loss tale
items.summary: Novo and DJ Khaled have teamed up to share how the DJ, rapper and record producer has incorporated the GLP-1 drug Wegovy into his weight-loss routine.

items.title: Pharmas should stay agile as Democrats amp up scrutiny over Trump's MFN deals
items.summary: Industry experts are calling for pharma leaders to ready for heavier oversight as a newly blue Congress demands an unredacted look at President Trump's controversial MFN drug pricing deals.

items.title: Gilead rolls out the red carpet for HIV prevention at the Latin Grammy Awards
items.summary: Gilead's collaboration with TelevisaUnivision and the 27th Latin Grammy Awards puts HIV prevention in the spotlight with in-person, social and red-carpet activations.

items.title: FDA appears to pause controversial speedy review program, complete response letter disclosures
items.summary: The FDA has quietly shelved the Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program, Reuters reports. Meanwhile, the agency also appears to have paused publishing complete response letters after briefly halting—and then resuming—the practice in July.

items.title: Orzeyful's 'lighter' DEA schedule paves way for Takeda's first-in-class narcolepsy launch
items.summary: With a positive classification from the DEA paving the way for Orzeyful’s U.S. launch on Thursday, Takeda is charting new territory in the treatment of narcolepsy type 1 as it de-risks other assets in its budding orexin franchise in parallel.
